_readme: Engineering Design database. The website reads only the 'items' list; every key starting with _ is a note and is ignored.
One entry = one collapsible block in the Engineering Design tab of the device whose id is in 'deviceId'.
To add a model: upload the .glb to GitHub, then add one entry to 'items' (copy _entry_template).
Entries are shown in the order they appear here. Put new entries right after the last entry of the same device.
'deviceName' is only a human label for you; the website ignores it. Set "hidden": true on an entry to hide it without deleting it.
